_comment: Enemy roster (issue #16; Chapter 2 adds the Abbey kinds, issue #28). kinds: stats per enemy type, read by scripts/enemy_kinds.gd (hp, damage, speed, xp; the Nibbler's bite stays in scripts/enemy.gd; pack = how many spawn together (one fewer, sometimes); blank = born of the Blank, so it also crawls out of surges and Blots in Defense and Reclaim missions (the others only roam the land); tip = one-line hint shown the first time one notices the party; inflict = a status its hits can cause: {status, chance, time}, see scripts/status.gd, issue #112). rosters: spawn weights per province (the Act 1 areas); a mission can override with its own "enemies" dict; anything not listed uses default.

spitter.name: Spitter
spitter.tip: Spitter: it swells before it spits, and the spit can Erase you: no abilities or techs for a few seconds. Step aside, then close in.

moth.name: Letter-moth
moth.tip: Letter-moths: they flash red, then dive. Swing as they come in.

enforcer.name: Tithe Enforcer
enforcer.tip: Tithe Enforcer: his Ledger shield halves hits from the front. Hit him from behind, and leave the red ring: it stuns.

reedling.name: Reedling
reedling.tip: Reedlings: marsh mud that spits, and the mud poisons. They swell first, so sidestep and wade in.

scarecrow.name: Mill scarecrow
scarecrow.tip: Mill scarecrow: it twitches before the sickle swings. Step out of reach.

sellsword.name: Guild sellsword
sellsword.tip: Guild sellswords: fast, in pairs, and their lamp-oil blades can set you alight. Watch for the lunge.

penitent.name: Blotted Penitent
penitent.tip: Blotted Penitents: monks the Blank half-ate. Slow, in pairs, and the scourge can Erase you. They hunch before they swing.

copyist.name: Copyist
copyist.tip: Copyist: it kneels and copies a strip of floor out of the world. Step off the dotted line, then run it down. A hit while it kneels spoils the copy.

reader.name: Eraser Reader
reader.tip: Eraser Readers: Verity's followers, in pairs, with burning tapers. They read a line aloud, then lunge. Step aside.

whitewasher.name: Eraser Whitewasher
whitewasher.tip: Eraser Whitewasher: it hangs back and flings whitewash. A splash can Erase you: no abilities or techs for a few seconds. It dips the brush first.
